title: Spicy Gochujang Grilled Chicken Thighs
shortDescription: Boneless chicken thighs are marinated with gochujang, gochugaru, garlic, and ginger, then grilled over controlled heat to 165°F / 74°C.
culturalContext: Spicy seasoned grilled chicken appears in many contemporary Korean home and restaurant forms. This locked gochujang-thigh formulation is restaurant-style and not presented as one universal recipe.
author: {{LEGAL_NAME}}
equipment: Outdoor grill or manufacturer-approved indoor electric grill

ingredients.preparation: opened to even thickness; do not wash

mixOrder: Whisk gochujang, gochugaru, soy sauce, and rice syrup.
Add garlic, ginger, and sesame oil.
marinadeOrSeasoning.marinationVessel: Nonreactive covered container at or below 40°F / 4°C
marinadeOrSeasoning.maximumPracticalMarinationWarning: Do not exceed 8 hours without test-cook approval.
marinadeOrSeasoning.reserveBeforeRawContactInstruction: Reserve any serving sauce before the marinade contacts raw chicken.
marinadeOrSeasoning.rawContactDiscardOrReboilInstruction: Discard marinade that contacted raw chicken; do not use it on cooked food.
substitutions: Use only verified gluten-free gochujang and tamari for a gluten-free adaptation.

instructions.heading: Prepare without washing
instructions.action: Open thighs to even thickness on a dedicated board; do not wash raw chicken.
instructions.safetyNote: Washing raw poultry can spread contamination by splashing.

instructions.heading: Mix marinade
instructions.safetyNote: Reserve any serving sauce before raw contact.

instructions.heading: Marinate cold
instructions.action: Coat chicken, cover, and refrigerate for 1 hour.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Every thigh has a thin coating.
instructions.safetyNote: Never marinate poultry at room temperature.

instructions.heading: Preheat controlled zones
instructions.action: Preheat medium direct and cooler zones on an outdoor or approved electric grill.
instructions.visualOrTactileCue: Grate is hot, clean, and lightly oiled.
instructions.safetyNote: Never use a fuel-burning grill indoors.

instructions.heading: Grill and verify every piece
instructions.action: Grill, turning and moving to the cooler zone as needed, until every thigh reaches 165°F / 74°C.
instructions.safetyNote: Use clean tongs after the final turn and check multiple pieces.

instructions.heading: Rest and serve
instructions.action: Transfer to a clean platter, rest 3 minutes, and serve.
instructions.safetyNote: Do not return cooked chicken to the raw platter.

grillSetup: Use an outdoor grill or approved indoor electric grill with medium direct and cooler zones; control sugary-marinate scorching and separate raw and cooked tools.
targetInternalTemperature: 165°F / 74°C in the thickest part of every chicken piece.
visualDonenessCues: Surface is browned without burned sugar
foodSafetyNotes: Keep chicken at or below 40°F / 4°C and prevent cross-contact.
Cook every piece to 165°F / 74°C with a clean calibrated thermometer.

allergens.crossContactWarning: Contains soy, wheat/gluten, and sesame; verify gochujang and soy sauce labels.

substitutions: Use only verified gluten-free gochujang and tamari for a gluten-free adaptation.
ingredientSourcing: Choose cold chicken thighs in intact packaging and transport them home promptly.
makeAhead: Mix marinade up to 2 days ahead; marinate chicken only within the stated refrigerated range.
storage: Refrigerate cooked chicken in a shallow covered container within 2 hours and use within 4 days pending review.
leftovers: Use properly refrigerated leftovers within the approved window.
servingSuggestions: Serve with rice, lettuce wraps, and cooling banchan.

faq.question: Why use medium heat?
faq.answer: Gochujang and rice syrup can burn before chicken reaches 165°F / 74°C.

faq.question: Can color prove safety?
faq.answer: No. Check every piece with a thermometer.

metaDescription: Grill spicy gochujang chicken thighs with refrigerated marination, no-wash poultry handling, controlled heat, clean tools, and a 165°F / 74°C endpoint.
